notes.title: accelerating hotkeys 1.1.0
notes.content:
[h2]1.1.0 - March 28, 2022[/h2]

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] full controller support
[*] a stock exchange system
[*] an extended console
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] changed/extended some secrets
[*] changed some elements to be slightly randomized
[*] small performance improvements
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed the cigarette cool bonus being activated even when not actively working
[*] fixed camera rotation speed scaling with frame-rate
[/list]
